verses.text: Hallelu YAH! I will give thanks to YHWH with all of [my] heart, in the council of the upright and in the assembly.

segments.text: Hallelu YAH! I will give thanks to YHWH with all of [my] heart, in the council of the upright and in the assembly.

verses.text: Great [are] the works of YHWH, being searched out by all [who] delight in them.

segments.text: Great [are] the works of YHWH, being searched out by all [who] delight in them.

verses.text: Splendor and majesty [are] His work, and His righteousness stands forever.

segments.text: Splendor and majesty [are] His work, and His righteousness stands forever.

verses.text: A memorial He has made by His wonders; gracious and compassionate [is] YHWH.

segments.text: A memorial He has made by His wonders; gracious and compassionate [is] YHWH.

verses.text: Food He has given to those fearing Him; He remembers His covenant forever.

segments.text: Food He has given to those fearing Him; He remembers His covenant forever.

verses.text: The power of His works He has declared to His people, by giving to them the inheritance of the nations.

segments.text: The power of His works He has declared to His people, by giving to them the inheritance of the nations.

verses.text: The works of His hands [are] truth and justice, [and] all His precepts are trustworthy.

segments.text: The works of His hands [are] truth and justice, [and] all His precepts are trustworthy.

verses.text: They are upheld for ever everlasting; they are made in truth and uprightness.

segments.text: They are upheld for ever everlasting; they are made in truth and uprightness.

verses.text: Redemption He has sent to His people; He has appointed His covenant forever; Holy and awesome [is] His name!

segments.text: Redemption He has sent to His people; He has appointed His covenant forever; Holy and awesome [is] His name!

verses.text: The beginning of wisdom [is] the fear of YHWH; good understanding [is] unto all those doing it. May His praise be enduring forever!
